name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Qwen FP8)
notes: Verified on one DGX Spark 2026-10-09: ready in 6.5 min (weights 33.6 GiB), 2.98M tokens of KV cache at 256k context (11.35x) with 0.80, ~49 tok/s for one stream with thinking off, tool calls work, right answers in English and Swedish. MoE with 3B active, Qwen's own FP8 checkpoint, on the spark-arena nightly image; vLLM picks the DeepGEMM FP8 MoE backend there, and the answers were right (DeepGEMM gave nonsense for MiMo on the official image). The settings come from a single-Spark Easypanel service that ran it well: FlashInfer attention, decode-only CUDA graphs, Mamba cache align. That service also used YaRN x2 for 512k context and its own sampling (temperature 0.1, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, repetition_penalty 1.1, presence_penalty 0.15); here the context is the native 256k and clients choose the sampling. Thinking is on by default and long (several thousand characters for a simple question); turn it off per request with chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false}. Unsloth's NVFP4 variants did not start on DGX Spark with flashinfer_b12x (2026-10-09). Fits on one Spark; with two it is split across both.
